title: Union Education Minister launches three flagship digital initiatives of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan
subtitle: Shri Pralhad Joshi calls for expanding the initiatives to benefit students across the school education ecosystem
body_text: Union Minister for Education, Shri Pralhad Joshi, inaugurated three flagship digital initiatives of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) in New Delhi today. These include the AI-integrated Vidya Samiksha Kendra (VSK) with the ‘Samiksha’ AI Bot, KVS-Samvaad Parent Connect App and Web Portal, and the KVS Alumni Connect Portal. This marks a major milestone in KVS's journey towards technology-enabled, transparent and efficient administration. Describing the initiatives as a significant step towards realising the objectives of National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and advancing the vision of Digital India, the Minister congratulated the team and encouraged stakeholders to further strengthen and showcase the initiatives for wider adoption. He called for scaling up the initiative across every Kendriya Vidyalaya, covering all classes and locations. He also encouraged stakeholders to adopt a continuous learning approach, assess outcomes, and address areas requiring improvement. Shri Joshi suggested that the initiative be extended beyond KVS to benefit students across the entire school education ecosystem, in collaboration with the Department of School Education and Literacy (DoSEL). Highlighting the importance of capacity-building of teachers, he suggested incorporating comprehensive teacher training data into the portal. He stated that this should include details of training status of the teachers, training intervals, previous training records and upcoming training requirements. He emphasised that integrating these details into an online platform would facilitate better monitoring and ensure timely training. Secretary, DoSEL, Shri T. K. Anil Kumar; Joint Secretary, DoSEL, Ms. Prachi Pandey; Commissioner, Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan, Shri Vikas Gupta; and senior officials of the Ministry of Education were also present at the launch. AI-integrated Vidya Samiksha Kendra The AI-integrated Vidya Samiksha Kendra ( samiksha.kvs.gov.in ) provides real-time dashboards on student and staff attendance, academic performance, school infrastructure and admissions. Its ‘Samiksha’ AI Bot analyses data, identifies gaps and suggests interventions, enabling informed and timely decision-making. KVS-Samvaad – Parent Connect App and Web Portal The KVS Samvaad Parent Connect App and Web Portal ( samvaad.kvs.gov.in ) brings schools closer to parents by providing real-time attendance, progress of syllabus, academic results, learning resources and digital student ID cards. Parents can also apply online for Bonafide and CEA certificates and student leave, besides accessing student and teacher diaries. This will reduce paperwork and unnecessary school visits while strengthening parent-teacher communication. KVS Alumni Portal The KVS Alumni Portal ( alumni.kvs.gov.in ) provides a dedicated platform for former students to reconnect with their schools and batchmates, share achievements and experiences, and contribute towards mentorship, career guidance and institutional development. Developed in-house by the IT Services Cell of KVS Headquarters, the platforms aim to make essential information and services accessible at one click, saving valuable time and effort for parents, students, teachers and administrators. They reaffirm KVS's commitment to making educational services more accessible, responsive, transparent and efficient. ******* RRTN/AV
